# Comfy Colab Kit

> Wake-on-demand ComfyUI on Google Colab. A small aiohttp gateway (comfy-gate) on a VPS behind Cloudflare Access
> shows a Hugging-Face-Space-style wake page, starts one shared Colab L4 session via the colab CLI, streams progress
> to every viewer over SSE, reverse-proxies ComfyUI (incl. /ws) through a Cloudflare tunnel, and auto-stops on idle,
> max session, quiet hours or compute-unit budget. Profiles describe models by public URL and community/official workflows (vendored only when Apache-2.0/MIT, otherwise by URL).

## Docs
- [README](README.md): overview, quick start, structure
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): module map, state machine, invariants for coding agents
- [docs/README.md](docs/README.md): documentation map and agent fast path
- [docs/AGENT_SKILL.md](docs/AGENT_SKILL.md): how an agent wakes, uses, and stops a deployed gate
- [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): components, data flow, shared session, proxy
- [docs/PROFILES.md](docs/PROFILES.md): profile format, ComfyUI passthrough, App mode
- [docs/AUTO_STOP.md](docs/AUTO_STOP.md): every stop rule and its .env variable
- [docs/DEPLOY_VPS.md](docs/DEPLOY_VPS.md), [docs/CLOUDFLARE.md](docs/CLOUDFLARE.md): deployment
- [docs/SECURITY.md](docs/SECURITY.md): secrets, scanning, threat model
- [docs/WAKE_PAGE.md](docs/WAKE_PAGE.md): wake page and overlay UI
- [docs/API.md](docs/API.md): HTTP API summary
